item.title: 2026-01-16 Paper published in National Science Review
item.description:
Our paper, titled “Organization of mouse prefrontal cortex subnetwork revealed by spatial single-cell multi-omic analysis of SPIDER-Seq”, has been published in National Science Review.

About this paper:

Leqiang Sun, Hu Zheng, et al. Organization of mouse prefrontal cortex subnetwork revealed by spatial single-cell multi-omic analysis of SPIDER-Seq, National Science Review, 2026, nwag004.

item.title: 2026-01-12 Paper published in Plos Biology
item.description:
Our paper, titled “A single-cell spatiotemporal transcriptomic atlas of mouse prefrontal cortex maps dynamics of intratelencephalic neurons during postnatal development”, has been published in PLOS Biology.

About this paper:

Hu Zheng, Keji Yan, et al. A single-cell spatiotemporal transcriptomic atlas of mouse prefrontal cortex maps dynamics of intratelencephalic neurons during postnatal development. PLOS Biology. 24(1):e3003594.

item.title: 2025-11-19 Hu Zheng received the OSPP project completion certificate!
item.description:
Hu Zheng participated in the 2025 Open Source Promotion Plan (OSPP) and completed the project “Extension of Bizard, an Open-Source Biomedical Visualization Toolkit” under the guidance of Prof. Shixiang Wang.

About Bizard:

  • Project: https://zhengtiger.github.io/project/bizard/
  • Publication: https://zhengtiger.github.io/publication/bizard-a-community-driven-platform-for-accelerating-and-enhancing/
